complaint: My arm hurts a little bit after I fell off the shelf.

choices.label: Rest it and tell a grown-up
choices.feedback: Great choice! Resting and telling a grown-up is always the safest first step.

choices.label: Just keep playing and ignore it
choices.feedback: It's better to tell a grown-up so they can check if you're okay.

choices.label: Put a soft bandage on it
choices.feedback: That can help a little, but it's still best to tell a grown-up too.

complaint: My tummy feels funny after lunch.

choices.label: Tell a grown-up how you feel
choices.feedback: Good! Telling a grown-up helps them take care of you.

choices.label: Drink a little water and rest
choices.feedback: Good idea, resting a little can help.

choices.label: Eat more candy
choices.feedback: If your tummy feels funny, more candy won't help. Better to tell a grown-up.

complaint: I have a tiny scrape on my knee.

choices.label: Wash it with water and put on a bandage
choices.feedback: Great! Washing it and covering it helps take care of the scrape.

choices.label: Show it to a grown-up
choices.feedback: Great idea, a grown-up can help you take care of it.

choices.label: Do nothing and keep playing
choices.feedback: It's better to wash the scrape or show it to a grown-up, so it doesn't get infected.

complaint: My nose is running and I keep sneezing.

choices.label: Use a tissue and rest
choices.feedback: Good! A tissue and some rest help you feel better.

choices.label: Tell a grown-up you don't feel well
choices.feedback: Good choice, a grown-up can take care of you.

choices.label: Keep playing and share toys without washing hands
choices.feedback: When you have a cold, it's important to wash your hands and cover your sneeze, so germs don't spread.

complaint: My eyes feel tired and heavy.

choices.label: Rest your eyes and take a little nap
choices.feedback: Great! Resting your eyes helps them feel better.

choices.label: Tell a grown-up that you're tired
choices.feedback: Good idea, grown-ups can help you get some rest.

choices.label: Keep looking at a bright screen
choices.feedback: Looking at screens when you're tired makes your eyes even more tired. It's better to rest.

complaint: I feel sad because my friend didn't want to play with me.

choices.label: Talk to a grown-up about how you feel
choices.feedback: Good! Talking about your feelings with a grown-up really helps.

choices.label: Take a deep breath and hug something soft
choices.feedback: That can help you feel a little better.

choices.label: Keep it all inside and say nothing
choices.feedback: It's always better to share your feelings with someone you trust.

complaint: I played so much I'm thirsty and sweaty.

choices.label: Drink some water and rest in the shade
choices.feedback: Great! Drinking water and resting helps your body feel better.

choices.label: Tell a grown-up you need a break
choices.feedback: Good idea, grown-ups can help you take a break.

choices.label: Keep running in the sun
choices.feedback: It's better to stop, drink water, and rest a little in the shade.

complaint: I bumped my head on the toy shelf.

choices.label: Tell a grown-up right away
choices.feedback: Well done! Bumping your head is always a reason to tell a grown-up right away.

choices.label: Sit still calmly and wait for help
choices.feedback: Good, staying calm while you wait is a good idea too.

choices.label: Keep jumping around
choices.feedback: After bumping your head, it's important to stop and tell a grown-up right away.
